title: Statistical analysis code for age-specific prognostic contrasts in cholangiocarcinoma
description: R code for a population-based analysis of how age modifies the cancer-specific mortality contrast between intrahepatic and extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. The repository contains no SEER records, derived patient-level data, manuscript files, or analysis results.
